errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The text "Приходи от електронна търговия (млрд. долара)" is the label for the blue data series in the legend, not the label for the Y-axis itself.

errors.text_span: без да се използват маркери или допълнителни линии
errors.evidence: The chart shows a thin solid orange line on top of the blue area, which represents the growth trend. The description incorrectly states that no additional lines are used for the growth percentages.
The legend entry for "Ръст" (Growth) consists of an orange square next to the word. The description incorrectly states that the legend identifies "кафявите проценти" (the brown percentages).
